affected.note: ATM transaction records at the Izumi-Chuo branch from 2020-01-11 to 2020-09-04, covering 5,503 customers. The CD-ROM was encrypted and was most likely discarded by mistake.

summary.en: Morinomiyako Shinkin Bank said an encrypted CD-ROM holding 19,679 ATM transaction records from its Izumi-Chuo branch, covering 5,503 customers, went missing and was probably thrown away with other documents. The data includes names, phone numbers, account details, amounts and camera images.
summary.ja: 杜の都信用金庫は、泉中央支店のATM取引情報19,679件（取引先5,503件）を記録した暗号化済みCD-ROMを紛失したと公表した。書類に紛れて誤廃棄した可能性が高く、氏名、電話番号、口座情報、取引金額、防犯カメラ画像などが記録されていた。

sources.title: ATMの取引情報が記録された記録媒体を紛失 - 杜の都信金
